comparison.objective: Plant and backfill a seedling plug, keeping it upright and undamaged.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a delicate plant while distributing and firming loose potting mix around it.
comparison.success_condition: Plug released upright at soil level, adequate four-sided fill and firmness, limited spill, no plant damage. Numeric rubric is present.
comparison.reason: Both involve loose material, but planting tests backfilling and compaction around a delicate plug; the candidate tests aperture-based size/orientation separation, bridge clearing, washer retention, and media recovery.
